**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 11 ("Transition Assistance and Data Return") satisfies the preferred TRANSITION position on every material term:

- **11.1** — up to **six months** transition assistance on expiry or termination for any reason, at the expiring Order Form rates, including knowledge transfer, export support, cooperation with a replacement supplier, and continued service at then-current scope and service levels.
- **11.2** — return of all Customer Data within **thirty days** in a complete, commonly used, documented, machine-readable format, with metadata and relationships, and an express prohibition on holding data hostage over a fee dispute (better than model language).
- **11.3** — secure deletion after we confirm successful return, certified in writing by an authorized officer, with any legally required retained copy remaining protected and use-restricted.

Cross-check: Section 16.5 expressly defers Customer Data to Sections 11 and 15, so the confidentiality return/destroy mechanic does not undercut these exit rights, and Section 10.1 preserves access during the agreed transition period. No walk-away features (immediate deletion or no data return) appear anywhere in the document.
